# A checkout for scripts/count-core-lines.sh, read by the thesis test
# core_source_stays_under_its_line_budget. Each `== path` line starts a
# file. In a file under src/, `+` starts a line the script counts as
# production and `-` one it excludes as test code; the marker and the space
# after it are not part of the file. Files elsewhere are written as they
# stand, and count only toward total-including-tests, except under a
# crate's target/, where they count toward nothing. Production code follows
# each kind of test-only item, so an item read as longer than it is shows,
# and each test-only module file sits where rustc would look for it.
== crates/alpha/src/lib.rs
+ //! Test code in the middle of a production file, before more production.
+
+ use std::fmt;

- #[cfg(test)]

- #[cfg(test)]
- type Seen = HashMap<String, u32>;

+ /// Brackets, quotes and attribute text inside literals and comments.
+ pub fn tricky<'a>(s: &'a str) -> (&'a str, &'static str, &'static str, [char; 4], u8) {
+     // } a closing brace in a line comment
+     /* a { brace, /* a nested } comment */ and a } brace */
+     let raw = r#"a raw "} { string"#;
+     let _ = (b"} \" {", c"{ \" }");
+     // Without spaces, a quote read wrongly pairs with the next one.
+     let _ = ('é','}', '\'','{');
+     (s, "} #[cfg(test)] mod hidden { \" {", raw, ['{', '}', '\'', '"'], b'}')
+ }
+
- /// A test-only helper, its doc comment included.
- #[cfg(test)]
- fn helper() -> &'static str {
-     "}"
- }

-     fn literals() {
-         assert_eq!(tricky("{").0, "{");
-         let _ = (r"\", '\\', "{{{", br##"raw "# }"##);
-     }
-
-     // Never read: the module around it is excluded whole.
-     #[cfg(all(test, unix))]
-     macro unread() {}
-     fn after_unread() {}
- }
